description: Main window: core APIs only. SQLite goes through the app's own db bridge (study database and bundled translations), never arbitrary paths. Window: drag by the top strips (data-tauri-drag-region). Updates: check, download and install signed releases, then relaunch. Links: only the author's site (roobi.dev) and the online translations' publisher sites (esv.org, newlivingtranslation.com, which their terms ask the app to link to) open in the system browser.
